# A butterfly net (generated by make_env.py), origin at the hoop's centre.
new
material new Hoop --base-color 0.467 0.267 0.282 --no-slot
material new Mesh --base-color 0.431 0.722 0.659 --no-slot
material new Handle --base-color 0.933 0.612 0.365 --no-slot
add mesh torus --name Hoop --major-segments 12 --minor-segments 4 --major-radius 0.42 --minor-radius 0.045 --location 0 0 0
material assign Hoop
add mesh cone --name Bag --vertices 10 --radius1 0.06 --radius2 0.4 --depth 0.55 --location 0 0 -0.3 --cap-fill none
material assign Mesh
add mesh cylinder --name Handle --vertices 5 --radius 0.04 --depth 1.5 --location 0 -1.1 0.45 --rotation -60 0 0
material assign Handle
select all
shade flat
export net.glb
